title: Data Scientist
description: Build and evaluate machine learning models on business data. Clean data with pandas and numpy, train models with scikit-learn, apply statistics and communicate findings through data visualization. Experience with Python and SQL is essential.

title: Full-Stack Web Developer
description: Design and build responsive web applications. Create user interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React, and develop REST APIs with Node.js and a database such as MongoDB or SQL. Use Git for collaboration.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protect systems and networks. Perform network security monitoring, vulnerability assessment and penetration testing, respond to incidents, work with SIEM tools and Linux servers, and apply cryptography and firewall best practice.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate build, test and deployment. Containerise services with Docker and Kubernetes, run infrastructure on AWS with Terraform, maintain CI/CD pipelines, script in Bash and Python, and monitor systems on Linux.
